question: What determines whether a ritual consecration is weak or powerful?
premises: The contemplative firmness of the practitioner can be strong or weak.
This can be observed during or after the ritual performance.
inference: The efficacy of consecration depends on the firmness of the underlying recognition, not merely on the external act.
plain_english: For this very reason, even there, depending on whether firmness or lack of firmness is seen—while the rite is being performed or after it is done—the consecration may be slight or great.
